title: [GMCP 203.037.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Configuration import, export, migration, and desired state
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-037-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: GMCP losslessly imports and exports major MCP host configurations while separating secrets, preserving unknown fields and reporting unsupported semantics. One versioned desired-state schema covers servers, transports, auth, sandbox, policy and extensions; migrations are reversible and idempotent; layered overrides explain provenance; and concurrent edits use validation plus atomic conflict handling. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
